explanation: Eighteen months, and the sources name the mechanism rather than leaving it to be inferred: the Empire lost the political support of the large landowners because of the abolition of 1888, which was carried without compensating the slaveholders, and the slaveholding agrarian elite took it as a personal act of the imperial family. The monarchy was deposed by army officers, not by planters; but it was deposed without anyone defending it, and this is why nobody did.
